Synthetic Layered Skillet Nachos

Total: 1 hour. Serves 6 to 8.

Ingredients

  • 6 tomatoes or 1 can fire-roasted tomatoes
  • 4 slices bacon
  • 8 oz Mexican chorizo
  • 12 oz beef sirloin
  • salt and black pepper
  • 1 white onion
  • 2 jalapeños or 3 serrano chiles
  • 3 cloves garlic
  • 1 bag tortilla chips
  • 2 cups melting cheese
  • 1 avocado
  • 1/2 cup queso fresco
  • scallions

Preparation

  1. Broil the fresh tomatoes until blistered, then chop; use canned tomatoes directly if chosen.
  2. Cook the bacon in a skillet until crisp and set it aside.
  3. Add the Mexican chorizo and cook while breaking it into small pieces.
  4. Brown the beef sirloin, soften the white onion and chiles, then stir in the garlic.
  5. Stir in the tomatoes, salt and black pepper and reduce to a thick sauce.
  6. Spread tortilla chips in a baking dish, add the meat mixture and melting cheese, then bake.
  7. Garnish with avocado, queso fresco and scallions before serving.
